summary:
In government initiatives and welfare, the Bihar government is expanding its Chief Minister Nari Shakti Yojna to include women from Economically Weaker Sections (EWS) and Other Backward Classes (OBC), offering financial aid and coaching assistance for competitive examinations. In the banking sector, financial institutions are rolling out campaigns on responsible borrowing and credit score awareness to mitigate risks from digital lending and bad loans among young borrowers.

In international relations and technology, Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Uzbekistan President Shavkat Mirziyoyev engaged in joint environmental initiatives by planting saplings in Tashkent to bolster green cover and bilateral cooperation. Concurrently, the World Bank highlighted that artificial intelligence provides substantial opportunities for India to enhance productivity, employment generation, and living standards.

In security and agriculture, Indian intelligence agencies identified new evasive communication tactics by terror networks in Jammu and Kashmir, including the use of encrypted tools and niche chat features. In sustainable farming, Manipur's traditional 'Yum Ingkhol' system is being recognized as an indigenous foundation for organic and natural farming models in Northeast India.
keyFacts: Bihar's Chief Minister Nari Shakti Yojna expanded to include women from EWS and OBC categories for exam coaching and financial support.
PM Narendra Modi and Uzbekistan President Shavkat Mirziyoyev held bilateral engagements and planted saplings in Tashkent.
World Bank MD Paschal Donohoe stated AI can significantly boost India's jobs, productivity, and living standards.
Banks launched a responsible borrowing campaign to address digital lending risks and educate youth on credit discipline.
Traditional Manipuri homestead system 'Yum Ingkhol' highlighted as a foundational model for natural and organic farming.
Security agencies uncovered alternative covert communication channels, including encrypted apps and gaming/site chats, used by terror groups in J&K.

mcqs.question: The government of Bihar has recently expanded the 'Chief Minister Nari Shakti Yojna' to include women from which of the following categories?

options.a: Only Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes
options.b: Economically Weaker Sections (EWS) and Other Backward Classes (OBC)

mcqs.explanation: The Bihar government expanded its Chief Minister Nari Shakti Yojna to include women from Economically Weaker Sections (EWS) and Other Backward Classes (OBC).

mcqs.question: What is the primary support provided to women beneficiaries under Bihar's Chief Minister Nari Shakti Yojna?

options.b: Financial aid and coaching assistance for competitive examinations
options.c: Free healthcare and health insurance coverage

mcqs.explanation: The scheme offers financial assistance and coaching support for women preparing for competitive examinations.

mcqs.question: Which state government recently expanded its Nari Shakti Yojna to provide exam coaching support to EWS and OBC women?
mcqs.explanation: The initiative was announced by the Bihar state government to support female aspirants from EWS and OBC backgrounds.

mcqs.question: Financial institutions and banks have recently launched awareness campaigns primarily aimed at addressing which of the following challenges?

options.a: Promoting physical branch banking over digital channels
options.b: Risks from digital lending and rising bad loans among young borrowers
options.c: Mandating cryptocurrency investments for rural households

mcqs.explanation: The campaigns focus on responsible borrowing and credit score awareness to mitigate risks from digital lending and credit defaults among youth.

mcqs.question: The recent banking campaigns regarding 'responsible borrowing' specifically target which demographic to instill credit discipline?

options.b: Young borrowers and digital loan users

mcqs.explanation: Banks are focusing on young borrowers who access credit via digital lending platforms to educate them on credit discipline and credit scores.

mcqs.question: Prime Minister Narendra Modi recently planted saplings to bolster bilateral green initiatives alongside President Shavkat Mirziyoyev of which country?
mcqs.explanation: PM Narendra Modi held bilateral engagements and planted saplings alongside Uzbekistan's President Shavkat Mirziyoyev.

mcqs.question: In which city did PM Narendra Modi and Uzbekistan President Shavkat Mirziyoyev undertake a joint sapling-planting initiative?
mcqs.explanation: The joint environmental initiative of planting saplings took place in Tashkent, Uzbekistan.

mcqs.question: What was the primary bilateral and environmental objective of the joint sapling-planting event held in Tashkent?

options.a: To initiate timber export trade agreements
options.b: To boost green cover and strengthen bilateral cooperation
options.c: To establish an international wildlife corridor

mcqs.explanation: The sapling-planting initiative was conducted to enhance green cover and foster deeper bilateral ties between India and Uzbekistan.

mcqs.question: According to recent observations by the World Bank, which emerging technology offers significant potential to boost India's jobs, productivity, and living standards?
mcqs.explanation: The World Bank highlighted that Artificial Intelligence provides substantial opportunities for India to drive employment, productivity, and living standards.

mcqs.question: Who among the following World Bank officials recently emphasized the role of Artificial Intelligence in boosting India's economic productivity and employment?
mcqs.explanation: World Bank Managing Director Paschal Donohoe stated that AI can substantially enhance India's productivity, employment generation, and living standards.

mcqs.question: The indigenous farming concept known as 'Yum Ingkhol', recently in the news, is traditionally practiced in which Indian state?
mcqs.explanation: 'Yum Ingkhol' is an indigenous homestead farming system from Manipur recognized for organic and natural farming models.

mcqs.question: What is the core feature of the traditional 'Yum Ingkhol' system of Northeast India?

options.b: Traditional homestead system serving as a foundation for natural and organic farming

mcqs.explanation: Manipur's 'Yum Ingkhol' is an indigenous homestead system that provides a structural foundation for sustainable, natural, and organic farming.

mcqs.question: 'Yum Ingkhol' is being promoted in Northeast India as an indigenous model for which agricultural practice?
mcqs.explanation: 'Yum Ingkhol' is recognized as a foundational traditional model for organic and natural farming in the Northeast region.

mcqs.question: In which Union Territory/State did Indian intelligence agencies uncover new evasive communication tactics utilized by terror networks?
mcqs.explanation: Intelligence agencies detected alternative covert communication tactics employed by terror networks operating in Jammu and Kashmir.

mcqs.question: According to intelligence reports, which methods are increasingly being deployed by terror networks in Jammu and Kashmir to evade surveillance?

options.a: Traditional shortwave radio broadcasts and morse code
options.b: Encrypted tools, niche chat features, and gaming platform chats
options.c: Standard unencrypted SMS and satellite telephony

mcqs.explanation: Terror groups in J&K have been found utilizing encrypted applications, niche chat services, and gaming platform chat tools as covert communication channels.
